name: partner-technical-heats
description: Pairs only share equipment and go in heats: each athlete does the full workout. Owner concern 2026-11-21.
rawText:
PARTNER WOD
In pairs - share a rower
Partner A goes, Partner B starts when A finishes
3 rounds for time:
500m Row
15 Wall Ball 9/6kg
10 Burpee
Each athlete records own time
